# D163 triage hints (generated by tools/re/triage.py ingest; never hand-edit)

Hints, never evidence (D56, D167, D172): no matching tool reads them; the client's asserts, strings, object boundaries and objmatch decide. A hint is reliable when the file has a name in the evidence; it cannot name an object nobody named and then picks the nearest named file. Treat a **low**-confidence hint, or a hint for a function at a file boundary (the nearest known functions before and after it in different files), as a lead: confirm the object's boundaries (statics, literals, padding) before placing.

Model claude-sonnet-5-5; 14753 application-range functions (D170), in `triage.json` (the evidence each answer cited in `triage-evidence.tsv`); `python tools/re/triage.py show ADDR` prints one, `plan` the runs of neighbouring functions with no pair and one suggested file.
